<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Start a large export"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/v1/exports"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Runs one read-only SELECT as the caller and writes the whole result to object storage: through the dataset engine (CSV or Parquet, no row cap) when the query reads `data.<table>` datasets alone, else through the query engine as CSV parts under the server's row cap. Returns the export (202 while running; 200 when it finished within wait_seconds) with presigned download links once it has succeeded.
